title: Analysis of automation and retraining opportunities for the Brazilian federal public service

live_model.evidence: Abstract: "assessment of...automation of each job duty by GPT-4 Turbo"; "a prompt (Appendix 2) for the GPT-4 Turbo API was developed"

prompt.note: GPT-4 Turbo is queried via its API to assess automation importance/horizon per job duty, and separately to associate relevant technologies, with a required justification.

claim.metric: % of job duties classified with an immediate or short-term automation-impact horizon
claim.location: Abstract ("72% of the job duties with different automation levels in an immediate or short-term impact horizon"); "GPT-4 Turbo associated 59 technologies with the 1,136 job duties evaluated (Table 3)"

data.source: Job duties of 142 intermediate-level Brazilian federal public positions, extracted from an official government classification document

notes: Digital Government Research (dg.o 2025) conference paper. Data provenance ("a government document") is described but the specific document/URL was not directly confirmed in the excerpt read; treated as public given it is an official public-sector classification record. est_calls = 1,136 job duties x 3 seeds.
